description: Dutch real-time transit data is a data set deposited in DANS Data Stations by its authors S.A.M.M. De Konink. Automatic Vehicle Location (AVL) data is used for real-time arrival and departure prediction systems in Dutch public transport. This bulk dataset contains historical information a vehicle locations which where real-time monitored at an interval of 60s, and published their location at every stop. Next to identification and location other variables such as punctuality are available. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2014. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-dans-repository.
